About us

Work done well, for those who manage and those who live there

We are a building contractor specialised in condominium maintenance in Rome and surroundings.

We work with qualified crews and a structured organisation: inspection, photo report, clear quote and works followed to the end. Our reference clients are managers and owners.

How we work

1Qualified crews

Competent people at every stage of the site.

2Clear organisation

Times, costs and phases explained before starting.

3Documentation

Reports and photos for the manager and the meeting.
